The June3,2026 suspension/pass-as-amended question concerns the whole H.R.2860NorthwestStraitsCommission reorganization, science/data/advisory duties, reporting and sunset package. The original statutory402Commission establishment remains; the bill replaces403–405rather than creating the first-ever Commission or first-ever marine-data assistance. House passage is not enactment, funding or a restored ecosystem.
The originalTitleIVorganizes/operates the body by the August20,1998Report and permits Commerceassistance from available amounts for data/protection/restoration, with stated PadillaBay/NOAAchannels and noFederal-law-implementation power. The captured report edition identifies August20,1998and anApril2004reprint; the complete captured membership portion was read, but the remainder of the incorporated Report and later-law/currentcharter status were not conformed. Reprint introductory commentary is not treated as an independently verified statutory funding or sunset rule. The new bill's explicit governance/duties, not an invented complete net change from all unreviewed oldReportterms, ground this candidate.
New404sets14baseappointments: one by consensus for each of sevennamedcountyMRCs;twoInteriorappointments in fisheries-commission coordination/affectedTribalconsultation;oneGovernorappointment for PugetSoundPartnership;andfourGovernorappointedWashingtonresidents subject to the stated government-employment exclusion with higher-education exception. It is14base, not a permanent maximum: additional members may be appointed as necessary for duties through consensus of an MRCnotlisted in the base paragraph. Vacancies follow the original appointment route, the Commissionselects its chair and meets at leastquarterly.
The UnderSecretarymust appoint a NOAAemployee liaison in consultation with the Commission. Attendance at Commissionevents as a nonvoting participant may occur as agreed; liaisonservice does not create a fifteenth ordinary voting seat or obligate the employee to perform the Commission's405(b)duties. Statecooperativeagreements may support staffing/admin; nonprofitcooperativeagreements may provide assistance, including financial assistance, for the duties. No new fixed appropriation or guaranteed recipient payment is supplied by these provisions, and the old statutory funding paragraph is replaced rather than declared a still-identical new grant entitlement.
The whole duties include resources/technicalsupport forMRCs, advice in developing regional ecosystem-monitoring programs, collecting marine-resourcedata/identifying adverse factors to inform decisionmakers, scientifically sound locally informed restoration/protection recommendations, public discussion/information and affected-Tribalconsultation to ensure work does not violate treatyrights. Coordination includes technical assistance to Tribalgovernments seeking representation. The goal's science/measurable-results/local-priority language is not proof of an ecological cause or recovery. The Commissionhas no authority to issue regulations or implement Federal law or regulation; data/advice/recommendations are not binding permits, regulations or enforcement orders.
Each year the Commissionmust submit and make publicly available an activities/benchmark-progress report to the named Senate/Housecommittees and UnderSecretary. Benchmarks include habitat/resourcepopulation/water-quality/data-quality/monitoring dissemination and stewardship/outreach subjects, not pre-certified improvements. New406ends authority to carry out the title7yearsafterenactment, not7yearsafterHousepassage. The Tribalgovernment definition uses the most-recent statutory list as of enactment; individual list entries, current representative appointments and current funds are not certified.
A Yea supports this whole Commission/duties/report/sunset package; a Nay opposes it without a component-specific position or preferred alternative. Infrastructure/Technology membership is an UNACCEPTED candidate proposal based on explicit scientific monitoring-data collection, technical support and public benchmark reporting within the whole regional conservation/governance program. A competing boundary treats it as broad environmental/community conservation and advisory administration. Independent full-version/baseline/taxonomy review is required before acceptance/publication. No current charter validation, new fixed funding, binding regulation, measured restoration/water-quality benefit, treaty-compliance result, motive or accepted domain expansion is inferred.
